name: Hillcrest of Orchard
description: Hillcrest of Orchard is a working farm in 44100 State Highway 171, WI. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
